answer: Pairwise trellis check: each epoch, every identity meets three strangers at the wharf for an interview. Shared keystrokes, timing, or identical answers fail both and burn both bonds. Partners come from across the trellis, so fakes wander into honest strangers. Each fake costs 85 credits: a 40 bond plus 15 per pairing, so 1,000 fakes cost 85,000 against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent answers its own three pairings, pays 45 once, keeps its bond.
